flaws.locator: Theorem 1 (TeX label thm:HD), statement: 'Let P be a closed symplectic manifold and L in P its closed Lagrangian submanifold such that omega|pi_2(P,L) = 0, mu|pi_2(P,L) = 0. Suppose that a Hamiltonian H is admissible, quasi-autonomous and homotopic to zero through admissible Hamiltonians. Then it holds: d(phi^1_H, Id) = Delta(L, phi^1_H(L))' - the hypotheses on H (Definitions 5 and 6 of v1), per the withdrawal comment 'an error in the assumptions of the Theorem 1'; the proof (v1 Section 3, the chain (i)-(vii) through Theorems 10 and 11, the inequality of [L] and Schwarz's Theorem 7) is removed with the theorem in v3; the failing step is not named by the notice
